summary: Iteration 6 (Admin Console + backend hardening) fully verified. Added 9 pytest cases in tests/test_admin_flows.py covering admin/users RBAC + no password_hash leak, non-admin verification_status/rejection_reason stripping on nurse_profile & hospital (create + patch), hospital_verified server-computed on job create (forge blocked), admin hospital-verification propagation to jobs, admin approve pending job -> alerts + public visibility, admin reject job -> hidden from public + rejection_reason persisted, admin cross-tenant application/document read + nurse-to-nurse document RLS still 403. Full backend suite: 51/51 passing (42 regression + 9 new). Frontend Playwright E2E validated: unauthenticated /admin/dashboard -> /login redirect; admin login -> /admin/dashboard with ALL 10 stat testids present (208 nurses / 101 hospitals / 80 jobs / 51 applications live counts); nurse and hospital accounts both see 'not-an-admin-message' on /admin/*; every admin sidebar & mobile nav testid present; job approve flow (create pending job via API -> admin UI Review -> approve-job-btn -> confirm-dialog-confirm-btn -> job appears in /api/public/jobs); job reject flow (reject-job-btn + reject-reason-input + reject-dialog-submit-btn -> status=rejected + rejection_reason persisted + removed from /api/public/jobs); mobile 390x844 topbar burger opens sheet with all admin-mobile-nav-* links, no horizontal page overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 405 lines and mixes auth, generic CRUD, alerts, and admin-specific rules. Splitting by concern (routes/auth.py, routes/admin.py, services/alerts.py, security/ownership.py) will keep it maintainable as more admin actions are added.

Hospital verification propagation (server.py L387-388) uses updated.get('owner_id') to find the hospital's jobs and matches against jobs.hospital_id. This works only because hospital_key(user)==user['id'] for hospital accounts today. If multi-user hospitals are ever supported (users with a shared hospital_id), the join field will diverge; consider centralizing the hospital->owner mapping.

Admin approving a job via PATCH {'approved': true} correctly transitions was_live -> is_live and triggers generate_job_alerts. However, if an admin later PATCHes an already-live job (e.g., changes title), generate_job_alerts is not re-run (correct) but there is no separate signal for 're-notify'. Documenting this in the endpoint is worthwhile.
GET /api/admin/users returns up to 5000 users with no pagination; fine now but will need cursor/limit before growth.

verification_status stripping in create() (L305-308) always sets 'pending' for non-admins. If a client legitimately wanted to leave the field unset (e.g., partial profile drafts), it still receives 'pending' — arguably fine, but a stat card ('Pending Nurse Verification: 56') will inflate as soon as any nurse creates a profile. Consider only defaulting when the client did not send the field.
